output.summary: AI 에이전트의 코드 생성 속도 증가로 인한 인간 코드 리뷰 병목 문제를 다룬 발표다. 코드 작성량은 741% 증가한 반면 실제 배포된 소프트웨어는 30%만 늘었으며, 이는 리뷰 단계의 한계 때문이다. Cisco 연구에 따르면 리뷰어가 400~450줄을 초과하면 결함 탐지율이 급감하고, METR 연구에서는 테스트를 통과한 PR의 실제 머지 가능 비율이 약 50%에 그쳤다. FrontierCode 벤치마크에서 Fable 5는 SWE-Bench Pro 80.3%와 FrontierCode 29.3%로 큰 격차를 보였고, Bun의 Zig→Rust 포팅 코드에는 13,044개의 unsafe 블록이 포함되었다. 인간 리뷰어의 역할은 코드 직접 검토에서 검증 시스템 설계로 상향 이동하고 있으며, 개발팀은 검증 하네스 구축에 집중해야 한다.

Zapier - Administrative Automation
The Bottleneck
Engineers and teams at Zapier were losing valuable focus time to repetitive administrative work such as daily stand-ups, onboarding tasks, internal reporting, and routine Slack communications
The AI solution
Zapier's AI Agents team built an internal automation ecosystem where agents now run async stand-ups, summarize team updates, automate onboarding steps like email signature creation, and integrate seamlessly with Slack for approvals, notifications, and summaries.
The impact
The initiative has led to fewer synchronous meetings, faster onboarding (new engineers become productive within ~2 weeks), and an automation-focused culture. Zapier has actually ramped hiring as a result.

slides.text:
Spotify - Incident Management
The Bottleneck
When a production incident occurs, SREs often spend critical minutes and hours correlating alerts, digging through logs, and identifying the correct runbook steps.
The AI Solution
Spotify created an internal incident management agent platform that monitors logs and correlates alerts in real-time. When an incident is detected, the agent automatically suggests remediation steps from relevant runbooks directly into the SREs' communication channels.
The Impact
The platform is currently handling 90% of all incidents at Spotify, dramatically reducing mean time to resolution (MTTR) and freeing up SREs to focus on proactive reliability work.

Zapier - Administrative Automation
The Bottleneck
Engineers and teams at Zapier were losing valuable focus time to repetitive administrative work such as daily stand-ups, onboarding tasks, internal reporting, and routine Slack communications
The AI solution
Zapier's AI Agents team built an internal automation ecosystem where agents now run async stand-ups, summarize team updates, automate onboarding steps like email signature creation, and integrate seamlessly with Slack for approvals, notifications, and summaries.
The impact
The initiative has led to fewer synchronous meetings, faster onboarding (new engineers become productive within ~2 weeks), and an automation-focused culture. Zapier has actually ramped hiring as a result.

slides.text:
Spotify - Incident Management
The Bottleneck
When a production incident occurs, SREs often spend critical minutes and hours correlating alerts, digging through logs, and identifying the correct runbook steps.
The AI Solution
Spotify created an internal incident management agent platform that monitors logs and correlates alerts in real-time. When an incident is detected, the agent automatically suggests remediation steps from relevant runbooks directly into the SREs' communication channels.
The Impact
The platform is currently handling 90% of all incidents at Spotify, dramatically reducing mean time to resolution (MTTR) and freeing up SREs to focus on proactive reliability work.
